chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Silent Power Spike as Nine Lotos Chooses Her Dao-Companion
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning breaks through to the tenth stage of the Crimsonbright Diagram while Nine Lotos confesses her feelings to a jealous rival, setting the stage for a dramatic confrontation.
og_title: Jealousy and a Giant Leap in Power: Ji Ning's Quiet Ascension
og_description: The quiet life is over. As Nine Lotos chooses a Dao-companion, a love-struck rival plots, unaware that Ji Ning has just achieved a monstrous power increase.
twitter_title: A Rival Appears for Ji Ning's Dao-Companion Choice
twitter_description: While Chen Jin's world shatters, Ji Ning secretly becomes strong enough to battle Primal Daoists. The romantic storm is brewing.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, often referred to in non-romantic contexts as a cultivation partner.

surfaces: Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens
lore_anchors.definition: The number one Fiendgod Body Refining method in the Three Realms; each breakthrough stage requires comprehension of the Dao and a physical transformation.
A top-ten divine ability created by Daoist Threelives that allows the cultivator to use their hands as ultimate weapons, shattering defenses that resist flying swords.
A trial hall within the aquatic palace containing multiple levels; each level tests a cultivator's combat ability and offers treasures upon victory.
A legendary sword art by Immortal Beixing, characterized by an unrestrained, ruthless philosophy; Ji Ning has comprehended its third stance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is choosing a Dao-companion such a big deal in Xianxia?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a lifelong commitment on the path of cultivation that affects one's entire eternal life, making it much deeper and more significant than a mortal marriage.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Luo Qing leave if she supports Nine Lotos?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She felt useless as a third wheel and wanted to give the potential Dao-companions space while also not wanting to be idle while her senior sister cultivated.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Chen Jin going to be a threat to Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Very likely. jilted admirers are classic Xianxia troublemakers, and Chen Jin has the background and motivation to start a conflict, though Ji Ning's recent power spike will make it very one-sided.
